evals.name: start-long-migration
evals.prompt: heads up, this one is going to be long. we're moving all 6 billing cron jobs to the new scheduler, one PR per job, then a prod cutover and cleaning up the old crons. probably takes a couple of days and a few sessions. set yourself up so you don't lose track
evals.expected_output: A STATUS.md at the project root containing only an optional goal heading and one table with Item, Pointer, Status, Next columns; one row per job plus cutover and cleanup, all todo; the file excluded from git via .git/info/exclude; the reply shows the table and the absolute path.
assertions: A markdown tracker file exists on disk at a stable, non-temp path
The file holds a single table, with at most a one-line heading
The table columns are Item, Pointer, Status and Next
There is one row per job, plus rows for the cutover and the cleanup
Every status is a word from the skill's status set
Item names are short, two to five words
The tracker was not committed; it was added to .git/info/exclude when inside a git repo
The reply names the absolute path of the tracker

evals.name: join-after-compaction
evals.prompt: we've been at this for hours and you've compacted twice already, I can tell you're forgetting stuff. start tracking the work in a status file from now on
evals.expected_output: The agent rebuilds the table from the compaction summary, the conversation, git state and open PRs; rows it cannot confirm are marked unknown with verify in Next; it checks live state with cheap reads before setting statuses; it shows the table and path and names the rows still unknown.
assertions: The agent looked for an existing tracker before creating one
Rows were built from evidence (conversation, compaction summary, git, PRs), not invented
No row is marked done without the agent having seen it finished
Unconfirmed rows use the unknown status
The agent ran at least one live read (git, gh, or a status call) to confirm a row
The reply names any rows still unknown
The reply names the absolute path of the tracker

evals.name: update-on-state-change
evals.prompt: ok PR for the invoice job is up, here it is https://github.com/acme/billing/pull/412. move on to the refund job
evals.expected_output: Before replying, the agent edits the existing invoice-job row in place: Pointer gets the PR link, Status becomes review. The refund-job row becomes doing. No duplicate rows are added.
assertions: The tracker was edited before the reply
The invoice job row now has the PR link as its pointer
The invoice job row status is review
The refund job row status is doing
No second row was appended for either item
